title: Learning Guitar - Gamified
author: hydrangers
selftext:
Years after putting it down, I've recently had the nagging feeling of picking up my guitar again. I decided to build a platform that allows me to import guitar tabs from the internet to learn any song. It also includes a tour mode (guitar learning campaign) that starts off with basic techniques and progressively gets harder with different songs and genres.

Originally I hadn't planned to release it, but it turned out to be a super fun project to work on, mixing my usual software development passion with music, which is a first time for me.

The game is called Melodic, and if you have a guitar, feel free to try it out!

[https://playmelodic.com/](https://playmelodic.com/)
